en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a low, wide waterfall with smooth cascading water in a rural landscape. People in old-fashioned clothing stand near the edge of the waterfall and along a path above it, with wooden fences, a small building, and trees in the background. The right side of the card is blank except for the printed place name "Goldingen.", while beneath the image is the caption "Reschewasserfall." and along the left margin is the publisher information printed vertically.
